precise_failures.failure: An unavailable source proposal was expected to be audit-only. Accepted authority requires unavailable material to remain unavailable/not-evaluated/abstained; audit-only is reserved for deleted material.

The expected source-producer result was deleted, but the exact raw producer input was explicitly pre-deletion and carried a present source passage. The later deletion event was not part of the producer input, so the expected result could not be produced by the declared seam.

missing_rule_correction.rule: Producer reachability and lifecycle closure now require exact raw-input-to-output mapping, unavailable-to-abstained, deleted-to-audit-only, and a producer-visible deletion premise before a deleted producer expectation.

comparison_consequence: No product comparison was run and no product behavior was changed from v13 expectations. The package is retained only as non-authorizing development history.
